title: The Twelve Dignities and the Twelve Greatnesses
description: T14 traces how the proprium consolidates as ruling principle and declares itself a foundation that nothing could move; from this boast all its productions flow — first generations, trees of death, painted dead-as-living, bitter fruit, masculine and feminine self-loves mingling. The proprium then sets itself against the Divine Human in great contest and is humbled. T15 unfolds the Lord's five Greatnesses as the complete divine going-forth in twelve degrees, reaching down to Adam and Eve's flesh: first the Lord in his inmost; second the life-bearing principle and Divine Human together; third the operative power; fourth the call with the path of regeneration; fifth divine truth shining as illumining wisdom — all returning home in the Last Andrias at consummation.
